description: Claude Rules - Global rules injection for all sessions (delegated to @fusengine/harness, scope 'rules'; reads ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/*.md) | SessionStart[0]: Inject all rules into session context at startup | SessionStart[0].hooks[0]: Load and inject rules/*.md into additionalContext (harness reads CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) | SubagentStart[0]: Inject all rules into each subagent's context at spawn (requires @fusengine/harness >= 0.1.63 which routes scope 'rules' on SubagentStart) | SubagentStart[0].hooks[0]: Load and inject rules/*.md into additionalContext (harness reads CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) | UserPromptSubmit[0]: Re-inject rules at every user prompt for persistent context | UserPromptSubmit[0].hooks[0]: Reload rules/*.md into additionalContext on each prompt (harness reads CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT)
